//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	win "golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const parentNotifyFilter uint32 = 0x1f
const parentNotifyLimit = 64 << 10

type parentNotifyItem struct {
	Action uint32
	Name   string
}
type parentNotifyKey struct{ Connection, MessageID uint64 }
type parentNotifyRequest struct {
	Key       parentNotifyKey
	Session   uint64
	FileID    string
	Filter    uint32
	Recursive bool
	Capacity  uint32
	At        time.Time
}
type parentNotifyResult struct {
	Request parentNotifyRequest
	Items   []parentNotifyItem
	At      time.Time
}

var parentNotifyRegistry struct {
	sync.Mutex
	requests   map[parentNotifyKey]parentNotifyRequest
	results    []parentNotifyResult
	incomplete bool
}

func parentNotifyDecode(data []byte) ([]parentNotifyItem, error) {
	if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > parentNotifyLimit {
		return nil, errors.New("empty or excessive notification buffer")
	}
	var items []parentNotifyItem
	for {
		if len(items) >= 256 || len(data) < 12 {
			return nil, errors.New("notification count or header bound")
		}
		next, action, length := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:]), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:])
		if action < 1 || action > 5 || length == 0 || length > 4096 || length&1 != 0 || uint64(length)+12 > uint64(len(data)) {
			return nil, errors.New("notification action or name length")
		}
		end := 12 + int(length)
		if next != 0 && (next&3 != 0 || uint64(next) < uint64(end) || uint64(next)+12 > uint64(len(data))) {
			return nil, errors.New("overlapping or truncated notification chain")
		}
		words := make([]uint16, length/2)
		for i := range words {
			words[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12+2*i:])
		}
		for i := 0; i < len(words); i++ {
			c := words[i]
			if c == 0 || c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid notification UTF-16")
			}
			if c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff {
				if i+1 == len(words) || words[i+1] < 0xdc00 || words[i+1] > 0xdfff {
					return nil, errors.New("unpaired notification surrogate")
				}
				i++
			}
		}
		items = append(items, parentNotifyItem{Action: action, Name: string(utf16.Decode(words))})
		if next == 0 {
			if len(data)-end > 3 {
				return nil, errors.New("unaccounted notification bytes")
			}
			for _, b := range data[end:] {
				if b != 0 {
					return nil, errors.New("nonzero notification padding")
				}
			}
			return items, nil
		}
		for _, b := range data[end:next] {
			if b != 0 {
				return nil, errors.New("nonzero notification entry padding")
			}
		}
		data = data[next:]
	}
}

func cacheGateParentNotifyRequest(packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if len(packet) < wire.HeaderSize+32 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(packet[wire.HeaderSize:]) != 32 {
		return false
	}
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	flags := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[2:])
	capacity := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(body[4:])
	if flags&^uint16(1) != 0 || capacity == 0 || capacity > parentNotifyLimit || r.Connection == 0 {
		return false
	}
	r.FileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[8:24])
	request := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{r.Connection, r.MessageID}, Session: r.SessionID, FileID: r.FileID, Filter: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(body[24:]), Recursive: flags&1 != 0, Capacity: capacity, At: time.Now()}
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	if parentNotifyRegistry.requests == nil {
		parentNotifyRegistry.requests = make(map[parentNotifyKey]parentNotifyRequest)
	}
	if len(parentNotifyRegistry.requests) >= 32 {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return false
	}
	if _, ok := parentNotifyRegistry.requests[request.Key]; ok {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return false
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.requests[request.Key] = request
	return true
}
func cacheGateParentNotifyResponse(packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if len(packet) < wire.HeaderSize+8 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(packet[wire.HeaderSize:]) != 9 {
		return false
	}
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	offset, length := uint32(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[2:])), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(body[4:])
	data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, offset, length, wire.HeaderSize+8)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	items, err := parentNotifyDecode(data)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	request, ok := parentNotifyRegistry.requests[parentNotifyKey{r.Connection, r.MessageID}]
	if !ok || request.Session != r.SessionID || length > request.Capacity || len(parentNotifyRegistry.results) >= 32 {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return false
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.results = append(parentNotifyRegistry.results, parentNotifyResult{Request: request, Items: items, At: time.Now()})
	return true
}
func parentNotifySnapshot() ([]parentNotifyRequest, []parentNotifyResult, bool) {
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	requests := make([]parentNotifyRequest, 0, len(parentNotifyRegistry.requests))
	for _, r := range parentNotifyRegistry.requests {
		requests = append(requests, r)
	}
	results := append([]parentNotifyResult(nil), parentNotifyRegistry.results...)
	return requests, results, parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete
}
func parentNotifyReset() {
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	parentNotifyRegistry.requests = make(map[parentNotifyKey]parentNotifyRequest)
	parentNotifyRegistry.results = nil
	parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = false
}

type parentNativeWatch struct {
	file    *nativeHandle
	event   win.Handle
	overlap win.Overlapped
	buffer  []byte
	done    bool
}

func parentWatchStart(t *testing.T, file *nativeHandle) *parentNativeWatch {
	t.Helper()
	event, err := win.CreateEvent(nil, 1, 0, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	w := &parentNativeWatch{file: file, event: event, buffer: make([]byte, parentNotifyLimit)}
	w.overlap.HEvent = event
	err = win.ReadDirectoryChanges(file.value, &w.buffer[0], uint32(len(w.buffer)), true, parentNotifyFilter, nil, &w.overlap, 0)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
		_ = win.CloseHandle(event)
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !w.done {
			err := win.CancelIoEx(file.value, &w.overlap)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_NOT_FOUND) {
				t.Error("cancel owned parent watcher:", err)
			}
			var count uint32
			err = win.GetOverlappedResult(file.value, &w.overlap, &count, true)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED) {
				t.Error("drain owned parent watcher:", err)
			}
			w.done = true
		}
		if err := win.CloseHandle(w.event); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		runtime.KeepAlive(w)
	})
	return w
}
func (w *parentNativeWatch) complete(deadline time.Time) ([]parentNotifyItem, error) {
	remaining := time.Until(deadline)
	if remaining <= 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("notification deadline exhausted")
	}
	timeout := uint32(remaining / time.Millisecond)
	status, err := win.WaitForSingleObject(w.event, timeout)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if status != uint32(win.WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("notification wait status %d", status)
	}
	var count uint32
	err = win.GetOverlappedResult(w.file.value, &w.overlap, &count, false)
	if errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_INCOMPLETE) {
		return nil, err
	}
	w.done = true
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if count > uint32(len(w.buffer)) {
		return nil, errors.New("native notification overflow")
	}
	return parentNotifyDecode(w.buffer[:count])
}
func parentAwaitPending(t *testing.T) parentNotifyRequest {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		requests, _, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if bad || incomplete {
			t.Fatal("incomplete notification request trace")
		}
		for _, request := range requests {
			if request.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !request.Recursive {
				t.Fatal("parent watcher used incorrect filter or recursion")
			}
			for _, r := range records {
				if r.Response && r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && r.Connection == request.Key.Connection && r.MessageID == request.Key.MessageID && r.Status == 0x103 {
					finished := false
					for _, final := range records {
						if final.Response && final.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && final.Connection == request.Key.Connection && final.MessageID == request.Key.MessageID && final.Status != 0x103 {
							finished = true
						}
					}
					if finished {
						t.Fatal("watch completed before the measured mutation")
					}
					return request
				}
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("parent watch never reached actual SMB STATUS_PENDING")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

type parentInvalidationQualification struct {
	Watched                            bool
	Pending                            bool
	NativeModified                     bool
	WireModified                       bool
	SameConnection                     bool
	Quiet                              bool
	FreshTargetTraffic                 bool
	TraceComplete                      bool
	ACK, FirstExposure, EarliestExpiry time.Time
	WriteStarted, NotifyCompleted      time.Time
	Native                             cacheGatePositiveValue
	Initial, Expected                  storage.Attr
}

func parentInvalidationClassify(q parentInvalidationQualification) (string, bool) {
	if !q.TraceComplete || !q.SameConnection || !q.Quiet || q.Native.Error != "" || q.Native.Started.Before(q.ACK) || q.Native.Completed.Before(q.Native.Started) || q.Native.Completed.After(q.ACK.Add(time.Second)) || !q.Native.Completed.Before(q.EarliestExpiry) || q.FirstExposure.IsZero() || q.FirstExposure.After(q.Native.Started) || q.Expected.ID != q.Initial.ID || q.Initial.Size != 257 || q.Expected.Size != 769 || q.Expected.MetadataRevision <= q.Initial.MetadataRevision || q.Expected.ModTime.Equal(q.Initial.ModTime) {
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	if q.Watched && (!q.Pending || !q.NativeModified || !q.WireModified || q.NotifyCompleted.Before(q.WriteStarted) || q.NotifyCompleted.After(q.Native.Started) || q.NotifyCompleted.IsZero()) {
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	current := q.Native.Size == q.Expected.Size && q.Native.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(q.Expected.ModTime)
	old := q.Native.Size == q.Initial.Size && q.Native.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(q.Initial.ModTime)
	if !q.Watched {
		if old {
			return "control_old_first_sample_observation_only", false
		}
		if current {
			return "control_current_first_sample_observation_only", false
		}
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	if current && q.FreshTargetTraffic {
		return "current_before_deadline", true
	}
	if old {
		return "stale_first_sample_observation_only", false
	}
	return "inconclusive", false
}
func parentHasModified(items []parentNotifyItem) bool {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Action == win.FILE_ACTION_MODIFIED && item.Name == `v\target` {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func parentConnectionProof(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, request *parentNotifyRequest) (uint64, uint64, bool) {
	var connection, session uint64
	var childID, targetID string
	rootMatched := false
	for _, r := range records {
		if !r.Response || r.Command != wire.Create || r.Status != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if r.Name != "" && r.Name != "v" && r.Name != `v\target` {
			continue
		}
		if connection == 0 {
			connection, session = r.Connection, r.SessionID
		}
		if connection != r.Connection || session != r.SessionID {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if r.Name == "" && request != nil && r.FileID == request.FileID {
			rootMatched = true
		}
		if r.Name == "v" {
			childID = r.FileID
		}
		if r.Name == `v\target` {
			targetID = r.FileID
		}
	}
	if connection == 0 || session == 0 || childID == "" || targetID == "" || targetID == childID {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	if request != nil && (request.Key.Connection != connection || request.Session != session || request.FileID == "" || request.FileID == childID || request.FileID == targetID || !rootMatched) {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	return connection, session, true
}

type parentNativeCall struct {
	API, Path          string
	Started, Completed time.Time
}

func parentHarnessQuiet(calls []parentNativeCall, writeStarted time.Time, first cacheGatePositiveValue) bool {
	selected := 0
	for _, call := range calls {
		if call.API == "first-attributes" {
			selected++
			if call.Started.After(first.Started) || call.Completed.Before(first.Completed) {
				return false
			}
			continue
		}
		if call.API == "notify-wait" {
			continue
		}
		if !call.Completed.Before(writeStarted) && call.Started.Before(first.Completed) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return selected == 1
}
func parentRefreshProof(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, writeStarted time.Time, first cacheGatePositiveValue, connection uint64, expected storage.Attr, notify *parentNotifyResult) (bool, string) {
	for _, request := range records {
		if request.Response || request.Bootstrap || request.Connection != connection || request.At.Before(writeStarted) || request.At.After(first.Completed) || request.Name != `v\target` {
			continue
		}
		if request.Command != wire.Create && !(request.Command == wire.QueryInfo && request.QueryType == 1 && (request.QueryClass == 18 || request.QueryClass == 34)) {
			continue
		}
		for _, response := range records {
			if !response.Response || response.Connection != request.Connection || response.SessionID != request.SessionID || response.MessageID != request.MessageID || response.Command != request.Command || response.Status != 0 || response.At.Before(request.At) || response.At.After(first.Completed.Add(200*time.Millisecond)) || response.EOF != uint64(expected.Size) || response.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(expected.ModTime) {
				continue
			}
			if notify != nil && (notify.Request.Key.Connection != connection || notify.At.Before(writeStarted) || notify.At.After(response.At)) {
				continue
			}
			if !response.At.After(first.Started) {
				return true, "refreshed_before_first_api"
			}
			if !request.At.Before(first.Started) {
				return true, "refreshed_by_first_api"
			}
		}
	}
	return false, "ambiguous_refresh_provenance"
}
func parentJoinSelectedTrace(first cacheGatePositiveValue, pending *parentNotifyRequest) ([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, bool) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(200 * time.Millisecond)
	for {
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if incomplete {
			return records, true
		}
		notifyJoined := pending == nil
		if pending != nil {
			_, results, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
			if bad {
				return records, true
			}
			for _, result := range results {
				if result.Request.Key == pending.Key {
					notifyJoined = true
				}
			}
		}
		for _, request := range records {
			if request.Response || request.At.Before(first.Started) || request.At.After(first.Completed) || request.Name != `v\target` || (request.Command != wire.Create && request.Command != wire.QueryInfo) {
				continue
			}
			for _, response := range records {
				if response.Response && response.Connection == request.Connection && response.MessageID == request.MessageID && response.Command == request.Command && response.Status != 0x103 && notifyJoined {
					return records, false
				}
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return records, false
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

type parentInvalidationReport struct {
	Name                  string
	ShareMode             uint32
	Order                 string
	UNC                   string
	Qualification         parentInvalidationQualification
	Classification        string
	WithinOneSecondProven bool
	EvidenceValid         bool
	Initial, Expected     storage.Attr
	Warm                  []cacheGatePositiveValue
	Pending               *parentNotifyRequest
	NativeNotify          []parentNotifyItem
	WireNotify            []parentNotifyResult
	Wire                  []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	Events                []cacheGateEvent
	Error                 string
	NativeCalls           []parentNativeCall
	Mechanism             string
	CandidateFailed       bool
	OracleVerified        bool
	OwnersClean           bool
	TestFailed            bool
}

func parentExposure(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) time.Time {
	var first time.Time
	for _, r := range records {
		if r.Response || r.Command != wire.Create || (r.Name != "" && r.Name != "v" && r.Name != `v\target`) {
			continue
		}
		if first.IsZero() || r.At.Before(first) {
			first = r.At
		}
	}
	return first
}
func parentCheckPolicy(t *testing.T, bridge *nativeBridge) {
	t.Helper()
	if bridge.wire.unsafeCaching.Load() || bridge.wire.leaseResponses.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("parent probe received caching rights")
	}
	bridge.wire.mu.Lock()
	defer bridge.wire.mu.Unlock()
	formal := false
	for _, n := range bridge.wire.negotiations {
		if (n.Dialect != 0x311 && n.Dialect != 0x2ff) || n.Capabilities != 4 {
			t.Fatalf("unsupported negotiation in parent probe: %+v", n)
		}
		formal = formal || n.Dialect == 0x311
	}
	if !formal {
		t.Fatal("parent probe lacks SMB3.1.1 negotiation")
	}
}
func parentAppShareProof(t *testing.T, bridge *nativeBridge, share uint32) {
	t.Helper()
	bridge.wire.mu.Lock()
	defer bridge.wire.mu.Unlock()
	for _, c := range bridge.wire.creates {
		if c.Name == "v" && c.ShareAccess == share && c.Access&win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY != 0 && !c.Truncated {
			return
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("application LIST/share mode was not observed on the child directory")
}
func parentRunCell(t *testing.T, name, order string, share uint32, watched bool, report *parentInvalidationReport) *parentInvalidationReport {
	t.Helper()
	trace := &cacheGateTrace{}
	cacheGateActive.Store(trace)
	cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
	parentNotifyReset()
	var bridge *nativeBridge
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cacheGateActive.Store(nil)
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		_, results, notifyIncomplete := parentNotifySnapshot()
		report.Wire, report.WireNotify = records, results
		trace.mu.Lock()
		report.Events = append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
		traceBad := trace.overflow || trace.encodingError != nil
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		report.OwnersClean = false
		if bridge != nil {
			status := bridge.smb.Status()
			sessions, refs := bridge.backend.activeState()
			report.OwnersClean = sessions == 0 && refs == 0 && bridge.backend.openReferences() == 0 && status.Connections == 0 && status.RetainedConnections == 0 && status.PendingRequests == 0 && status.UnconfirmedMutations == 0 && status.CleanupFailures == 0 && status.LeaseSlots == 0 && status.LeaseBytes == 0
		}
		report.EvidenceValid = !incomplete && !notifyIncomplete && !traceBad && report.OwnersClean && report.OracleVerified && report.Classification != "inconclusive" && !t.Failed()
		if !report.EvidenceValid {
			report.Classification = "inconclusive"
			report.WithinOneSecondProven = false
		}
		if incomplete || notifyIncomplete || traceBad || !report.OwnersClean {
			t.Error("parent probe evidence or resource cleanup incomplete")
		}
		if report.EvidenceValid && report.CandidateFailed {
			t.Error("ancestor notification did not make the first qualified query current; candidate failure is not a post-deadline SLO witness")
		}
		report.TestFailed = t.Failed()
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if err == nil {
			err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "parent-"+name+".json"), data, 0600)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	sid, err := CurrentUserSID()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	policy, err := AllowSID(sid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bridge = nativeBridgeFixture(t, policy)
	session, parent := nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "v", storage.NodeDirectory, true)
	file := nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "target", storage.NodeRegular)
	before, after := cacheGatePositivePayload(257, 0x17), cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x89)
	report.Initial = cacheGatePositiveInitial(t, session, file, before, 2001)
	if _, err := parent.Close(t.Context(), nativeAction(t, session)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("release setup-only parent claim:", err)
	}
	mappingStarted := time.Now()
	if err := bridge.mapDrive(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "map", Path: `\\127.0.0.1\` + bridge.share, Started: mappingStarted, Completed: time.Now()})
	report.UNC = `\\127.0.0.1\` + bridge.share
	path := report.UNC + `\v\target`
	var application *nativeHandle
	var watch *parentNativeWatch
	openApplication := func() {
		var err error
		started := time.Now()
		application, err = cacheGateSharingOpen(t, report.UNC+`\v`, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, share, true)
		report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "open-application", Path: report.UNC + `\v`, Started: started, Completed: time.Now()})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("application child LIST/share%d open: %v", share, err)
		}
	}
	openWatcher := func() {
		started := time.Now()
		parentHandle, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, report.UNC+`\`, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, 7, true)
		report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "open-watcher", Path: report.UNC, Started: started, Completed: time.Now()})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("parent LIST watcher open:", err)
		}
		started = time.Now()
		watch = parentWatchStart(t, parentHandle)
		report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "arm-watcher", Path: report.UNC, Started: started, Completed: time.Now()})
		pending := parentAwaitPending(t)
		report.Pending = &pending
	}
	if watched && order == "watcher_first" {
		openWatcher()
		openApplication()
	} else {
		openApplication()
		if watched {
			openWatcher()
		}
	}
	if application == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing application handle")
	}
	for range 2 {
		value := cacheGatePositivePath(path)
		report.Warm = append(report.Warm, value)
		report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "warm-attributes", Path: path, Started: value.Started, Completed: value.Completed})
		if value.Error != "" || value.Size != 257 || value.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(report.Initial.ModTime) {
			t.Fatalf("positive target warm failed: %+v", value)
		}
	}
	parentCheckPolicy(t, bridge)
	parentAppShareProof(t, bridge, share)
	records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	connection, _, same := parentConnectionProof(records, report.Pending)
	exposure := parentExposure(records)
	if incomplete || !same || exposure.IsZero() {
		t.Fatal("target and parent do not have complete same-connection exposure evidence")
	}
	if watched {
		pending := parentAwaitPending(t)
		if pending.Key != report.Pending.Key {
			t.Fatal("watch changed between preparation and mutation")
		}
	} else {
		for _, r := range records {
			if r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
				t.Fatal("no-watcher control issued CHANGE_NOTIFY")
			}
		}
	}
	action := nativeAction(t, session)
	q := parentInvalidationQualification{Watched: watched, Pending: watched, SameConnection: same, FirstExposure: exposure, EarliestExpiry: exposure.Add(cacheGatePositiveTTL(t)), Initial: report.Initial}
	q.WriteStarted = time.Now()
	receipt, err := file.WriteAt(t.Context(), storage.FileWriteRequest{Data: after}, action)
	q.ACK = time.Now()
	report.Expected = receipt.Observation.Attr
	q.Expected = report.Expected
	cacheGateObserve("parent_http_write_ack", map[string]any{"ack": q.ACK, "action": action, "receipt": receipt, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	if err != nil || receipt.State != storage.FileActionCompleted || receipt.Effects&storage.EffectContentChanged == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("remote growth outcome unknown: %+v, %v", receipt, err)
	}
	if watched {
		waitStarted := time.Now()
		items, notifyErr := watch.complete(q.ACK.Add(850 * time.Millisecond))
		q.NotifyCompleted = time.Now()
		report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "notify-wait", Path: report.UNC, Started: waitStarted, Completed: q.NotifyCompleted})
		report.NativeNotify = items
		if notifyErr != nil {
			report.Error = notifyErr.Error()
			report.Qualification = q
			t.Error("native parent notification inconclusive:", notifyErr)
			return report
		}
		q.NativeModified = parentHasModified(items)
	}
	q.Native = cacheGatePositivePath(path)
	report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: "first-attributes", Path: path, Started: q.Native.Started, Completed: q.Native.Completed})
	records, incomplete = parentJoinSelectedTrace(q.Native, report.Pending)
	_, results, notifyIncomplete := parentNotifySnapshot()
	q.TraceComplete = !incomplete && !notifyIncomplete
	q.Quiet = parentHarnessQuiet(report.NativeCalls, q.WriteStarted, q.Native)
	var matchingNotify *parentNotifyResult
	for _, result := range results {
		if report.Pending != nil && result.Request.Key == report.Pending.Key && result.Request.Filter == parentNotifyFilter && result.Request.Recursive && !result.At.Before(q.WriteStarted) && !result.At.After(q.Native.Completed.Add(200*time.Millisecond)) && parentHasModified(result.Items) {
			q.WireModified = true
			matched := result
			matchingNotify = &matched
		}
	}
	q.FreshTargetTraffic, report.Mechanism = parentRefreshProof(records, q.WriteStarted, q.Native, connection, report.Expected, matchingNotify)
	for _, r := range records {
		if !watched && r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
			q.TraceComplete = false
		}
		if r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && r.Response && r.Status != 0 && r.Status != 0x103 {
			q.TraceComplete = false
		}
		if r.Response && r.Command == wire.Create && (r.Oplock != 0 || r.LeasePresent || r.LeaseState != 0) {
			q.TraceComplete = false
		}
	}
	report.Qualification = q
	report.Classification, report.WithinOneSecondProven = parentInvalidationClassify(q)
	cacheGateObserve("parent_first_result", report)
	// The independent oracle runs only after the single measured native query.
	cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, file, report.Expected, after)
	report.OracleVerified = true
	runtime.KeepAlive(application)
	runtime.KeepAlive(watch)
	if report.Classification == "inconclusive" {
		t.Error("parent probe qualification failed; result is inconclusive")
	} else if watched && !report.WithinOneSecondProven {
		report.CandidateFailed = true
	}
	return report
}
func TestNativeParentInvalidation(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_VARIANT") != "positive_parent_invalidation" {
		t.Fatal("parent invalidation variant required")
	}
	reports := map[string]*parentInvalidationReport{}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		result := map[string]any{"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype ancestor notification diagnostic; not production mount or complete acceptance", "prototype": "1cb9ad7f49d998de4daa4d562d766b18cf06ce16", "cells": reports, "test_failed": t.Failed(), "cache_policy": "unchanged; verified by external harness", "geometry": "real share root / real child v / target; models synthetic parent only"}
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
		if err == nil {
			err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "receipt.json"), data, 0600)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	for _, cell := range []struct {
		name, order string
		share       uint32
		watched     bool
	}{
		{"noWatcher", "app_first", 0, false},
		{"share0_watcher_first", "watcher_first", 0, true},
		{"share0_app_first", "app_first", 0, true},
		{"share6_watcher_first", "watcher_first", 6, true},
		{"share6_app_first", "app_first", 6, true},
	} {
		reports[cell.name] = &parentInvalidationReport{Name: cell.name, ShareMode: cell.share, Order: cell.order, Classification: "inconclusive"}
		t.Run(cell.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			parentRunCell(t, cell.name, cell.order, cell.share, cell.watched, reports[cell.name])
		})
	}
}

func parentTestNotifyBuffer(items ...parentNotifyItem) []byte {
	var out []byte
	for i, item := range items {
		words := utf16.Encode([]rune(item.Name))
		size := 12 + 2*len(words)
		if i+1 < len(items) {
			size = (size + 3) &^ 3
		}
		block := make([]byte, size)
		if i+1 < len(items) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(block, uint32(size))
		}
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(block[4:], item.Action)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(block[8:], uint32(len(words)*2))
		for j, w := range words {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(block[12+2*j:], w)
		}
		out = append(out, block...)
	}
	return out
}
func TestParentInvalidationNotifyParsing(t *testing.T) {
	valid := parentTestNotifyBuffer(parentNotifyItem{3, `v\target`}, parentNotifyItem{3, `v\other`})
	items, err := parentNotifyDecode(valid)
	if err != nil || len(items) != 2 || !parentHasModified(items) {
		t.Fatalf("valid MODIFY buffer: %+v, %v", items, err)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func([]byte) []byte
	}{
		{"empty", func([]byte) []byte { return nil }},
		{"truncated", func(b []byte) []byte { return b[:11] }},
		{"odd UTF16", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[8:], 3); return b }},
		{"overlap", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, 12); return b }},
		{"out of bounds next", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, 0xfffffff0); return b }},
		{"invalid action", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[4:], 0); return b }},
		{"unpaired surrogate", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[12:], 0xdc00); return b }},
		{"huge", func([]byte) []byte { return make([]byte, parentNotifyLimit+1) }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := parentNotifyDecode(test.mutate(append([]byte(nil), valid...))); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed notification accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, items := range [][]parentNotifyItem{{{1, `v\target`}}, {{3, "target"}}, {{3, `v\target2`}}, {{3, `other\target`}}} {
		if parentHasModified(items) {
			t.Fatalf("wrong action or exact path accepted: %+v", items)
		}
	}
}
func TestParentInvalidationHookCorrelation(t *testing.T) {
	parentNotifyReset()
	t.Cleanup(parentNotifyReset)
	request := make([]byte, wire.HeaderSize+32)
	body := request[wire.HeaderSize:]
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 32)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[2:], 1)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], 4096)
	body[8] = 17
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[24:], parentNotifyFilter)
	r := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, MessageID: 7, SessionID: 13}
	if !cacheGateParentNotifyRequest(request, &r) {
		t.Fatal("valid notify request rejected")
	}
	payload := parentTestNotifyBuffer(parentNotifyItem{3, `v\target`})
	response := make([]byte, wire.HeaderSize+8+len(payload))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(response[wire.HeaderSize:], 9)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(response[wire.HeaderSize+2:], uint16(wire.HeaderSize+8))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[wire.HeaderSize+4:], uint32(len(payload)))
	copy(response[wire.HeaderSize+8:], payload)
	if !cacheGateParentNotifyResponse(response, &r) {
		t.Fatal("matching response rejected")
	}
	_, results, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
	if bad || len(results) != 1 || results[0].Request.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !results[0].Request.Recursive || !parentHasModified(results[0].Items) {
		t.Fatalf("decoded correlation lost: %+v bad=%v", results, bad)
	}
	other := r
	other.Connection = 2
	if cacheGateParentNotifyResponse(response, &other) {
		t.Fatal("different connection satisfied pending request")
	}
	parentNotifyReset()
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[24:], 3)
	if !cacheGateParentNotifyRequest(request, &r) {
		t.Fatal("valid different filter must remain observable")
	}
	requests, _, _ := parentNotifySnapshot()
	if len(requests) != 1 || requests[0].Filter == parentNotifyFilter {
		t.Fatal("filter mismatch was hidden")
	}
}
func TestParentInvalidationQualification(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("target shares observed parent connection", func(t *testing.T) {
		records := []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{
			{Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, Name: "", FileID: "root"},
			{Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, Name: "v", FileID: "child"},
			{Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, Name: `v\target`, FileID: "target"},
		}
		request := &parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 7}, Session: 9, FileID: "root"}
		if connection, session, ok := parentConnectionProof(records, request); !ok || connection != 1 || session != 9 {
			t.Fatal("complete target binding rejected", connection, session, ok)
		}
		if _, _, ok := parentConnectionProof(records[:2], request); ok {
			t.Fatal("parent-only trace proved target binding")
		}
		if _, _, ok := parentConnectionProof(records[:2], nil); ok {
			t.Fatal("no-watcher parent-only trace proved target binding")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func(*cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)
		}{
			{"different target connection", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Connection = 2 }},
			{"different target session", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.SessionID = 10 }},
			{"target open failed", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Status = 0xc0000001 }},
			{"target identity absent", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.FileID = "" }},
			{"target reused watcher identity", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.FileID = "root" }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				changed := append([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord(nil), records...)
				test.change(&changed[2])
				if _, _, ok := parentConnectionProof(changed, request); ok {
					t.Fatal("unproven target connection accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("harness ledger excludes automatic redirector traffic", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(200 * time.Millisecond)}
		calls := []parentNativeCall{{API: "warm-attributes", Started: at.Add(-time.Second), Completed: at.Add(-time.Millisecond)}, {API: "notify-wait", Started: at, Completed: at.Add(50 * time.Millisecond)}, {API: "first-attributes", Started: first.Started, Completed: first.Completed}}
		if !parentHarnessQuiet(calls, at, first) {
			t.Fatal("quiet native ledger rejected")
		}
		for _, api := range []string{"open-application", "warm-attributes", "enumerate", "get-info", "read"} {
			contaminated := append(append([]parentNativeCall(nil), calls...), parentNativeCall{API: api, Started: at.Add(25 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(30 * time.Millisecond)})
			if parentHarnessQuiet(contaminated, at, first) {
				t.Fatalf("intervening harness %s accepted", api)
			}
		}
		if parentHarnessQuiet(append(calls, calls[len(calls)-1]), at, first) {
			t.Fatal("multiple first queries accepted")
		}
		expected := storage.Attr{Size: 769, ModTime: at}
		request := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(10 * time.Millisecond), Connection: 2, SessionID: 9, MessageID: 7, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}
		response := request
		response.Response = true
		response.At = at.Add(30 * time.Millisecond)
		response.EOF = 769
		response.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(at)
		notify := parentNotifyResult{Request: parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{2, 5}}, At: at.Add(5 * time.Millisecond)}
		if fresh, mechanism := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, response}, at, first, 2, expected, &notify); !fresh || mechanism != "refreshed_before_first_api" {
			t.Fatal("automatic notify refresh was excluded", fresh, mechanism)
		}
		notify.At = at.Add(40 * time.Millisecond)
		if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, response}, at, first, 2, expected, &notify); fresh {
			t.Fatal("ambiguous notification ordering accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("successful response evidence", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(200 * time.Millisecond)}
		expected := storage.Attr{Size: 769, ModTime: at}
		request := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(150 * time.Millisecond), Connection: 2, SessionID: 9, MessageID: 7, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}
		response := request
		response.Response = true
		response.At = first.Completed.Add(time.Millisecond)
		response.EOF = 769
		response.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(at)
		if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, response}, at, first, 2, expected, nil); !fresh {
			t.Fatal("matched current response rejected")
		}
		if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request}, at, first, 2, expected, nil); fresh {
			t.Fatal("request dispatch became refresh proof")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func(*cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)
		}{
			{"failed", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Status = 0xc0000001 }},
			{"wrong size", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.EOF = 257 }},
			{"wrong mtime", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.MTime-- }},
			{"wrong connection", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Connection++ }},
			{"wrong session", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.SessionID++ }},
			{"wrong request", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.MessageID++ }},
			{"unbounded join", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.At = first.Completed.Add(201 * time.Millisecond) }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				r := response
				test.change(&r)
				if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, r}, at, first, 2, expected, nil); fresh {
					t.Fatal("uncorrelated or noncurrent response accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	old := storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 257, MetadataRevision: 2, ModTime: at.Add(-24 * time.Hour)}
	current := storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 769, MetadataRevision: 4, ModTime: at}
	valid := parentInvalidationQualification{Watched: true, Pending: true, NativeModified: true, WireModified: true, SameConnection: true, Quiet: true, FreshTargetTraffic: true, TraceComplete: true, ACK: at, WriteStarted: at.Add(-time.Millisecond), NotifyCompleted: at.Add(50 * time.Millisecond), FirstExposure: at.Add(-time.Second), EarliestExpiry: at.Add(4 * time.Second), Initial: old, Expected: current, Native: cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(200 * time.Millisecond), Size: 769, MTime: cacheGatePositiveTime(current.ModTime)}}
	if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(valid); classification != "current_before_deadline" || !proved {
		t.Fatal("qualified current result rejected", classification, proved)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*parentInvalidationQualification)
	}{
		{"no pending", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Pending = false }},
		{"wrong native action or name", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.NativeModified = false }},
		{"notification completed after first query", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.NotifyCompleted = q.Native.Started.Add(time.Nanosecond) }},
		{"wrong wire filter or name", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.WireModified = false }},
		{"different connection", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.SameConnection = false }},
		{"intervening ancestor query", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Quiet = false }},
		{"trace overflow", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.TraceComplete = false }},
		{"no authoritative target request", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.FreshTargetTraffic = false }},
		{"late completion", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) {
			q.Native.Completed = q.ACK.Add(time.Second + time.Nanosecond)
		}},
		{"expired oldest exposure", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.EarliestExpiry = q.Native.Completed }},
		{"query before ack", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Native.Started = q.ACK.Add(-time.Nanosecond) }},
		{"unknown error", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Native.Error = "I/O unknown" }},
		{"identity replaced", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Expected.ID++ }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			q := valid
			test.change(&q)
			if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(q); classification != "inconclusive" || proved {
				t.Fatalf("invalid proof accepted: %s %v", classification, proved)
			}
		})
	}
	q := valid
	q.Watched = false
	q.Native.Size = old.Size
	q.Native.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(old.ModTime)
	if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(q); classification != "control_old_first_sample_observation_only" || proved {
		t.Fatal("old first control became an SLO violation", classification, proved)
	}
	q.Native.Completed = q.ACK.Add(time.Second + time.Nanosecond)
	if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(q); classification != "inconclusive" || proved {
		t.Fatal("late control became timely proof", classification, proved)
	}
}
